import java.util.*;

public class Match {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_N = 7;
    static final int MAX2N = 1 << MAX_N;
    static final int MAX_M = 100;
    static final int MAX_S = 64184; // number of DP states for n=6

    static final int[] sizes = {0, 5, 11, 37, 137, 821, 7529, 164184};
    static final int MAX_SZ = 164184;

    static long[] p = new long[MAX_N][MAX_M];

    static class U128 {
        // Represents a 128-bit number stored as a BigInteger for convenience
        BigInteger bits;

        U128() {
            bits = BigInteger.ZERO;
        }

        U128(BigInteger b) {
            bits = b;
        }

        static U128 fromBit(int index) {
            return new U128(BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(index));
        }

        U128 or(U128 other) {
            return new U128(this.bits.or(other.bits));
        }

        U128 and(U128 other) {
            return new U128(this.bits.and(other.bits));
        }

        boolean any() {
            return !bits.equals(BigInteger.ZERO);
        }

        boolean getBit(int index) {
            return bits.testBit(index);
        }

        static U128 zero() {
            return new U128(BigInteger.ZERO);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (!(obj instanceof U128)) return false;
            return bits.equals(((U128) obj).bits);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return bits.hashCode();
        }
    }

    static int len;
    static U128[] bfs = new U128[MAX_S];
    static int SZ;
    static U128[] what = new U128[MAX_SZ];
    static int[] ind = new int[MAX_SZ];
    static int[][] next = new int[MAX2N][MAX_S];
    static int[] match = new int[MAX_S];

    static Map<U128, Integer> stateIndexMap; // For efficiency, can replace with custom hash

    static int get_ind(U128 state) {
        // Using a custom linear probing hash based on the code
        int pos = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
            pos = (pos * 2 + (state.getBit(i) ? 1 : 0)) % SZ;
        }
        while (true) {
            if (what[pos] == null) {
                what[pos] = state;
                bfs[len] = state;
                ind[pos] = len;
                len++;
                return len - 1;
            }
            if (what[pos].equals(state)) {
                return ind[pos];
            }
            pos = (pos + 1) % SZ;
        }
    }

    static void precalc(int n) {
        int N = 1 << n;

        U128[] fixed_size = new U128[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            fixed_size[i] = U128.zero();
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
            int cnt = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            fixed_size[cnt] = fixed_size[cnt].or(U128.fromBit(mask));
        }

        SZ = sizes[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < SZ; i++) {
            what[i] = null;
        }
        len = 0;

        get_ind(new U128(BigInteger.ONE)); // empty graph state

        for (int k = 0; k < len; k++) {
            U128 state = bfs[k];

            U128[] pred_hall = new U128[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) pred_hall[i] = U128.zero();

            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                if (state.getBit(mask)) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        pred_hall[i] = pred_hall[i].or(U128.fromBit(mask).or(U128.fromBit(i)));
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                U128 nxt = state;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (((mask & (1 << i)) ) != 0) {
                        nxt = nxt.or(pred_hall[i]);
                    }
                }
                next[mask][k] = get_ind(nxt);
            }

            for (int i = n; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (state.and(fixed_size[i]).any()) {
                    match[k] = i;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long expectedMaximumMatching(int n, int m, long[][] probMatrix) {
        long[] prev = new long[MAX_S];
        long[] cur = new long[MAX_S];

        prev[0] = 1;
        for (int k = 1; k < len; k++) prev[k] = 0;

        int N = 1 << n;
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                long prob = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    long pVal = probMatrix[i][j];
                    prob = (prob * ( ((mask & (1 << i)) ) != 0 ? pVal : (MOD + 1 - pVal) % MOD)) % MOD;
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < len; k++) {
                    cur[next[mask][k]] = (cur[next[mask][k]] + prob * prev[k]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            System.arraycopy(cur, 0, prev, 0, len);
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < len; k++) {
            if (match[k] == n) {
                ans = (ans + prev[k]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = n; // as per original code
        precalc(n);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                long val = sc.nextLong();
                p[i][j] = val * powmod(100, MOD - 2) % MOD;
            }
        }

        long ans = expectedMaximumMatching(n, m, p);
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }

    static long powmod(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1;
        a = a % MOD;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) != 0) res = (res * a) % MOD;
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
}
